info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — Editorial Workflow
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — Editorial Workflow.** Editorial workflows and the workflow builder, tasks and approvals, content scheduling, locking, version compare and content templates.

post.summary: Acquire a lock on content

201.description: The acquired lock plus the one-time `releaseToken` on success. A blocking exclusive clash answers 201 with `success: false` and `code: LOCKED_BY_OTHER` — not an error status.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Release a lock on content (owner only)

get.summary: Check lock status for content

200.description: Whether the item is locked, by whom, and the configured TTL. Expired locks are swept before answering, and the beacon token is never included.

post.summary: Extend (heartbeat) an existing lock

201.description: The lock with a pushed-out `expires_at`. If the lock had already expired the call re-acquires it, so the payload may carry a fresh `releaseToken` — or a blocking `code` if someone else took it meanwhile.

post.summary: Force-unlock content (same-org admin only)
Request the lock from its current holder (polite takeover)

201.description: Acknowledgement that the holder was notified and the request audited.

get.summary: List all active content locks for the organization

200.description: Every live lock of the organization with holder name and content slug, plus the configured TTL.

get.summary: Lock audit trail (force-unlocks, takeover requests) — same-org admin only

200.description: The 50 most recent audit entries of the organization, newest first.

post.summary: Release a lock via sendBeacon on tab close (release-token credential)
Create a recurring publish/unpublish schedule (RRULE subset, DST-correct)

201.description: The created series, with `next_run_at` already armed to the first occurrence.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List recurring schedules for the organization

200.description: All series of the organization, newest first, each with the joined `content_slug`.

get.summary: Preview the next occurrences of a recurring schedule

200.description: The next five occurrence instants in UTC, computed from the RRULE in the schedule’s IANA zone (not stored).

post.summary: Activate/deactivate a recurring schedule (reactivation re-arms the next occurrence)

201.description: The updated series. Reactivation re-arms `next_run_at` so a long-paused schedule does not fire for every missed occurrence.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List recurring schedules for a content item

200.description: Series targeting this content item, newest first. No `content_slug` on this endpoint (no join).

post.summary: Schedule content for future publish

201.description: The pending action. Any previously pending publish for the same content is cancelled first.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Schedule content for future unpublish

201.description: The pending action. Any previously pending unpublish for the same content is cancelled first.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Schedule content for future archive

201.description: The pending action. Any previously pending archive for the same content is cancelled first.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get all scheduled actions for a content item

200.description: Every action ever scheduled for this content item — pending and terminal — ordered by execution time.

get.summary: Get pending scheduled actions for a content item

200.description: Only the `pending` actions for this content item, ordered by execution time.

get.summary: List all pending scheduled actions for the organization

200.description: Pending actions across the organization, soonest first, each with the joined `content_slug`.

get.summary: Get scheduled actions as calendar events for a date range

200.description: Pending actions inside the requested window, flattened into calendar events (title = content slug).

post.summary: Schedule multiple content items at once

201.description: Partial-success summary: the content ids that were scheduled and the per-item failures.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List all releases for the organization

200.description: Releases of the organization, newest first, with `item_count` instead of the full item list.

post.summary: Create a new release with items

201.description: The created draft release with its items (release + items are one transaction).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get release by ID with items

200.description: The release with its items in execution order (the item join is org-scoped, so foreign content is not listed).
The updated release; 400 unless it is still a draft.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Add items to a release (draft only, upserts on conflict)

201.description: The release with the merged item list; an item already present has its action and sort order updated.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Remove items from a release (draft only)

200.description: The release with the remaining items; 400 unless it is still a draft.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Preflight validation: per-item readiness (existence, org, workflow approval, conflicts)

200.description: Per-item readiness plus the aggregate `empty` / `valid` verdicts. Read-only — it never changes the release.

post.summary: Publish a release immediately (preflight-checked; force=true overrides item warnings)

201.description: The release after execution: `published` when every item succeeded, otherwise `failed`, with the per-item outcome in `results`.

post.summary: Retry a failed release (re-executes only the failed items)

201.description: The release with merged `results` — previously successful items are kept, never re-executed. 400 unless the release is `failed`.

post.summary: Schedule a release for future publication

201.description: The release with `status: scheduled` and `scheduled_at` set. Preflight-checked; `force` overrides item warnings but never the empty-release check.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Cancel a scheduled release (reverts to draft)

201.description: The release back in `draft` with `scheduled_at` cleared; 400 unless it was `scheduled`.

get.summary: List versions (paginated) with change counts and author names

200.description: One page of versions (newest first) plus the total count. `limit` is clamped to 1–200 and defaults to 50; `offset` defaults to 0.

get.summary: Compare two versions (path-addressed field diff + ordered word diff)

200.description: Both snapshots side by side plus the field-level diff and its summary. 404 when either version does not exist for the content item.

get.summary: Diff a version against its immediate predecessor

200.description: The comparison against the nearest lower version (which need not be `version - 1` after pruning). `data` is `null` (with a `message`) when there is no predecessor.

get.summary: Get the organization version-retention policy

200.description: The stored policy. `data` is `null` when the organization has never configured one (CE default: keep everything).

put.summary: Set the organization version-retention policy (admin only)

200.description: The upserted policy. `keepLast` / `maxAgeDays` must be positive integers or null; `keepPublished` defaults to true.

post.summary: Redact a field path across ALL versions of a content item (admin only, audited)

201.description: How many versions had the field path overwritten with the `[redacted]` tombstone. 400 when `fieldPath` is not dot-separated identifiers.

get.summary: Redaction audit trail (admin only)

200.description: The 50 most recent redactions of the organization, newest first.

get.summary: List workflow definitions for current organization

200.description: All definitions of the organization, newest first. The list selects a narrower column set, so `version` is absent here.

post.summary: Create a new workflow definition

201.description: The created definition (version 1, active).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get workflow definition by ID

200.description: The full definition row; 404 when it does not exist in the caller’s organization.
The updated definition. A structural edit (states/transitions) snapshots a new version and bumps `version`; in-flight instances stay pinned to their own version.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a workflow definition (only if no active instances)

post.summary: Seed the default editorial workflow if none exist

201.description: The newest definition of the organization — the freshly seeded one, or the existing newest when workflows were already present. `null` only if the organization has no definitions at all.

post.summary: Migrate in-flight instances to the current definition version (state mapping)

201.description: Number of instances re-pinned to the definition’s current version.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get the active workflow instance for a content item

200.description: The newest instance for the content item, with the states/transitions of its pinned definition version. `data` is `null` when the content has no workflow instance.

get.summary: Workflows that can be started by hand for a content item

200.description: Active workflows bound to the content item’s type, for content without a workflow instance (Q17). `canStart` is false for viewers.

post.summary: Start a workflow for a content item

201.description: The created instance, standing on the definition’s initial state with a single `initialized` history entry. Only an active workflow bound to the content item’s type can be started (400 otherwise); viewers get 403; 400 when the content already has an active instance.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Assign the responsible user for a workflow instance

201.description: The instance with the new `assignee_id`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Transition the workflow to a new state

201.description: The instance after the transition, with the new entry appended to `history`. 409 when another transition won the race, 403 when a role gate or the four-eyes rule blocks it.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Create a task by hand (spec 56)

201.description: The new manual task (no workflow instance, `manual: true`). Assignee and linked content must belong to the caller's organization (404 otherwise).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List tasks for current organization

200.description: Tasks of the organization, newest first, optionally filtered by assignee and status. Each row carries the joined `content_id`, `current_state` and `workflow_name`.

get.summary: Open tasks (to do + in progress) assigned to the caller

200.description: Newest first.

get.summary: Get pending task count (optionally filtered by assignee)

200.description: Pending tasks for `assigneeId`, defaulting to the calling user.

get.summary: Get task by ID

200.description: The task with the joined `content_id` and `current_state` (no `workflow_name` on the single-task read).

put.summary: Edit a task (title, description, due date, priority, tags, linked content)

200.description: The updated task. Linked content can only be changed on manual tasks (409).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a manual task (workflow tasks are cancelled instead — 409)

patch.summary: Move a task on the board (pending / in_progress / completed / cancelled)

200.description: The task with its new status.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Mark task as completed

201.description: The task with `status: completed` plus `completed_by` / `completed_at` set.

post.summary: Cancel a pending task

201.description: The task with `status: cancelled`.

post.summary: Assign task to a user

201.description: The task with the new `assignee_id`. 404 when the assignee is not a member of the same organization.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List all available workflow templates

200.description: The built-in template gallery (simple approval, editorial review, multi-stage approval, legal compliance, translation).

get.summary: Get a workflow template by ID

200.description: The template. `data` is `null` (with an explanatory `message`) when no template carries that id.

post.summary: Create a workflow definition from a template

201.description: The definition created from the template. `data` is `null` (with a `message`) when the template id is unknown.

post.summary: Analyze a workflow definition for issues (dead-ends, orphans, unreachable finals)

201.description: Reachability/validity findings for the posted states and transitions.

post.summary: Get available transitions from a given state (for simulation)

201.description: The current state plus the transitions leaving it, filtered by `userRole` when one was supplied.

post.summary: Find shortest path from initial to a target state

201.description: The shortest transition sequence from the initial state to the target. `data` is `null` when there is no initial state, no target, or no path.

post.summary: Analyze an existing workflow definition by ID

201.description: Reachability/validity findings for the stored definition.

get.summary: Export a workflow definition as JSON

200.description: A portable `roadbeat-workflow-v1` document that the import endpoint accepts unchanged.

post.summary: Import a workflow definition from JSON

201.description: The definition created from the imported document.

post.summary: Duplicate an existing workflow definition

201.description: The copy — same states/transitions, every locale of `name` suffixed with " (Copy)".

get.summary: List content templates (optionally filtered by content type)

200.description: Templates of the organization, grouped by content type with the default first, then by English name.

post.summary: Create a content template

201.description: The created template. Setting `isDefault` clears the previous default of the same content type.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a content template

200.description: The template; 404 when it does not exist in the caller’s organization.
The updated template; omitted fields keep their previous value.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Get a template’s pre-filled data to seed a new content draft

201.description: The template’s pre-filled field values, ready to merge into a CreateContentDto. The shape is dynamic — it mirrors the JSON Schema of the template’s content type — so it is not modelled here.

data.description: Pre-filled field values (`{}` when the template stores none)

post.summary: Make this the default template for its content type

201.description: The template with `is_default: true`; the previous default of the same content type is cleared in the same transaction.

post.summary: Save an existing content item as a reusable template

201.description: The new template, carrying the source item’s content type and current field data (never the org default).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

lockType.description: Lock type: advisory (warns others) or exclusive (blocks others)

assigneeId.description: User ID to assign the task to

contentTypeId.description: Content type this template applies to

isDefault.description: Make this the default template for its content type

assigneeId.description: User ID of the assignee (same organization)

description.example: All content for the March 2026 product launch

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

errors.description: Present on 422 content-validation failures: one entry per rule that failed. Absent otherwise.

path.description: JSON pointer to the offending field

keyword.description: The rule that fired, e.g. required, after_field, before_field, requiredIf, requiredUnless, asset_exists, reference_exists

locks.description: All live locks of the organization, newest first

contentId.description: Content UUID that could not be scheduled

error.description: Why it failed (unknown content, date in the past, …)
error.example: Scheduled date must be in the future

scheduled.description: Content UUIDs that were scheduled successfully

failed.description: Per-item failures; the bulk call itself still succeeds

content_id.description: Content UUID that is locked (at most one live lock per item)

lock_type.description: `exclusive` blocks other users’ saves; `advisory` only warns them (they may still save).

expires_at.description: When the lock auto-expires unless heartbeated

user_name.description: Display name of the holder (joined from users — name only, data minimization). Null when the user has no name.

content_slug.description: Slug of the locked content item. Present on the organization-wide lock list only.

content_type_id.description: Content type this template applies to

name.description: Localized template name, keyed by locale

data.description: Pre-filled field values used to seed a new draft. The shape is dynamic — it mirrors the JSON Schema of `content_type_id`.

is_default.description: Auto-applied for its content type (at most one per org + type)

created_by_id.description: UUID of the creating user; null when that user was deleted

actor_id.description: UUID of the acting user (the admin, or the requester)

previous_holder_id.description: UUID of the user who held the lock at that moment; null when nobody did

actor_name.description: Display name of the actor (joined); null when the user was deleted

previous_holder_name.description: Display name of the previous holder (joined); null when unknown

success.description: False only when another user holds a blocking exclusive lock. An advisory clash still succeeds and carries a `warning`.

lock.description: The live lock — the caller’s own on success, the blocking holder’s on failure. Never carries the beacon `release_token`.

warning.description: English fallback text for an advisory clash (someone else is also editing)
warning.example: Jane Doe is also editing this content

message.description: English fallback text for a blocking clash
message.example: Content is locked by Jane Doe

code.description: Machine-readable outcome code clients translate with `params` (IMP-PRO-LOCK-07); absent on a clean acquire.

params.description: Interpolation values for the translated `code` message

lockTtlSeconds.description: Configured lock TTL, so clients can render expiry hints and pick a heartbeat rate

releaseToken.description: Beacon-release credential, returned ONLY to the lock owner on acquire/extend (IMP-PRO-LOCK-04). Never present in status payloads.

userName.description: Display name of the blocking / co-editing user, for client-side interpolation

locked.description: Whether a live (non-expired) lock exists on the content item

lock.description: The live lock; null when the content is unlocked

requested.description: Always true — the holder has been notified and the request audited. 404 when nothing is locked, 400 when the caller already holds the lock.

content_slug.description: Slug of the targeted content item (joined)

local_time.description: HH:MM wall-clock time of each occurrence, interpreted in `timezone`

next_run_at.description: Next occurrence in UTC. `null` while a poller replica holds the claim, or while the schedule is inactive.

last_run_at.description: When the previous occurrence ran; null before the first run

active.description: Inactive series are never claimed by the poller

created_by_id.description: UUID of the creating user (each occurrence executes as them)

content_slug.description: Slug of the targeted content item (joined). Present on the organization-wide list only.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `publishing` is the distributed claim a poller replica holds while executing the items.

scheduled_at.description: Planned publication instant in UTC; null while the release is a draft

published_at.description: When the release was last executed (also set on a failed run)

results.description: Per-item outcome of the last run; null before the first execution

items.description: The release items in execution order

id.description: Release item UUID (used by the remove-items endpoint)

action.description: What the release does to this item

content_slug.description: Slug of the content item (joined, org-scoped)

content_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the content item (joined)

results.description: Per-item outcome of the last run; null before the first execution

item_count.description: Number of items in the release

empty.description: True when the release has no items (never overridable by force)

valid.description: True when the release has items and every one of them is ready

contentSlug.description: Slug of the content item; null when the content no longer exists

exists.description: Whether the referenced content row still exists

orgMatches.description: Whether the content belongs to the release’s organization

workflowPublishable.description: Whether the workflow state allows publishing. Always true for non-publish actions and when pro-workflows is not installed.

workflowState.description: Current workflow state id; null when the content has no workflow instance

conflictingActions.description: Number of pending one-shot scheduled actions competing for the same content

title.description: Event title — the slug of the targeted content item

timezone.description: IANA zone the action was scheduled in

action.description: What happens at `scheduled_at`. `archive` unpublishes and soft-deletes.

scheduled_at.description: Execution instant in UTC (already converted from the submitted wall-clock time)

timezone.description: IANA zone the wall-clock time was interpreted in

status.description: Lifecycle state. `processing` is the distributed claim a poller replica holds while executing.

created_by_id.description: UUID of the scheduling user (the action executes as them)

executed_at.description: When the action actually ran (also set when it failed terminally)

error.description: Message of the last failed attempt; null while healthy

canStart.description: True when the caller may start a workflow here: not a viewer, and the content has no active instance yet

workflows.description: Active workflows bound to the content item’s type (empty when the content already has an instance)

diff.description: Field rows sorted changed → added → removed → unchanged, then by path

unchanged.description: Number of `unchanged` diff rows (top level only)

type.description: How the field differs. `unchanged` rows are emitted at the top level only.

oldValue.description: Left-hand value; absent for `added`. Any JSON type — scalar, object or array.

newValue.description: Right-hand value; absent for `removed`. Any JSON type — scalar, object or array.

textDiff.description: Word-level diff for `changed` leaves; null for structural rows and for values that cannot be rendered as text.

items.description: One page of versions, newest first

total.description: Total versions stored for the content item

content_id.description: Content UUID whose versions were redacted

field_path.description: Dot-separated field path that was overwritten with the tombstone

versions_touched.description: How many versions the redaction touched

actor_id.description: UUID of the administrator who performed the redaction

actor_name.description: Display name of the actor (joined); null when the user was deleted

versionsTouched.description: Number of historical versions in which the field path was overwritten

organization_id.description: Organization the policy belongs to (primary key)

keep_last.description: Keep at most this many versions per content item (newest first); null = unlimited. The current version is never pruned.

keep_published.description: Never prune snapshots whose status is `published`

max_age_days.description: Prune versions older than this many days; null = no age limit

status.description: Lifecycle status the snapshot was taken in

data.description: The stored field values. The shape is dynamic — driven by the content type JSON Schema.

status.description: Lifecycle status this snapshot was taken in

createdByName.description: Org-scoped display name for `createdBy` (names only — no emails); null when the user is unknown or outside the organization.

fieldCount.description: Number of top-level fields in the snapshot

changeCount.description: Top-level fields that differ from the preceding version; null for the oldest version on the page.

segments.description: Ordered LCS op-list — the positionally correct basis for highlighting (IMP-PRO-VER-03).

addedWords.description: Inserted words, derived from `segments`; kept for API compatibility

removedWords.description: Deleted words, derived from `segments`; kept for API compatibility

op.description: Run kind in the ordered op-list

text.description: The words of this run, space-joined

isValid.description: True when no issues were found

issues.description: Human-readable problems (missing initial/final state, dead ends, orphans)

reachableStates.description: States reachable from the initial state

orphanCount.description: States unreachable from the initial state

label.description: Localized button label, keyed by locale

targetName.description: Localized name of the target state; empty object when the state is unknown

requiredRoles.description: Roles allowed to perform it; empty array = unrestricted

name.description: Localized workflow name, keyed by locale

content_type_ids.description: Content type ids this workflow applies to; empty array = all types

is_active.description: Inactive definitions are kept but not offered for new instances

version.description: Structural version (IMP-PRO-WF-06); bumped on every states/transitions edit. Omitted by the list endpoint, which selects a narrower column set.

_format.description: Export envelope format marker (accepted back by the import endpoint)

name.description: Localized workflow name, keyed by locale

contentTypeIds.description: Content type ids the workflow applies to

label.description: Localized button label, keyed by locale

workflow_version.description: Definition version this instance is pinned to (IMP-PRO-WF-06) — later structural edits do not affect it.

assignee_id.description: Responsible user UUID; null when unassigned

history.description: Append-only transition log. Entries carry `from`/`to`/`timestamp`/`userId` and optionally `comment` or `action` (`initialized`, `version_migration`).

workflow_name.description: Localized name of the workflow definition (joined)

workflow_states.description: States of the instance’s pinned definition version

workflow_transitions.description: Transitions of the instance’s pinned definition version

migrated.description: Number of in-flight instances moved to the definition’s current version

label.description: Localized button label, keyed by locale
Localized button label, keyed by locale

from.description: The initial state the walk started from

to.description: Target state; defaults to the first final state when none was requested

length.description: Number of steps in the path

currentState.description: The state the simulation is standing on

stateName.description: Localized name of the current state; empty object when `currentState` is not part of the definition.

isFinal.description: Whether the current state is terminal

availableTransitions.description: Transitions leaving the current state, filtered by `userRole` when supplied

stateName.description: Localized state name, keyed by locale

isDeadEnd.description: Non-final state with no outgoing transitions

id.description: State id, unique within the workflow

name.description: Localized state name, keyed by locale

isInitial.description: Entry state of the workflow (exactly one per definition)

isFinal.description: Terminal state — instances in it no longer block deletion

allowsPublish.description: Content in this state may be published even though the state is not final (IMP-PRO-WF-04). Final states always allow publishing.

requiredRoles.description: Roles allowed to hold content in this state

taskRules.description: Tasks auto-created when an instance enters this state (IMP-PRO-WF-07); pending tasks of the exited state are cancelled on transition.

count.description: Number of pending tasks matching the filter

workflow_instance_id.description: Workflow instance UUID; null for a manual task

type.description: Task kind. Free-form; auto-created tasks use the state’s task-rule type.

assignee_id.description: Assigned user UUID; null when unassigned

status.description: Task lifecycle state (board columns: pending → in_progress → completed)

due_date.description: SLA due date; null when the task has no deadline

reminded_at.description: When the overdue reminder was emitted (exactly-once claim, IMP-PRO-WF-08)

escalated_at.description: When the task was escalated past its SLA window (IMP-PRO-WF-08)

created_by.description: UUID of the user who created a manual task

content_id.description: Linked content: a manual task’s own link, else the workflow instance’s content

current_state.description: Current state of the instance (joined); null for a manual task

workflow_name.description: Localized name of the workflow definition (joined). Present on the list endpoint only.

type.description: Task type created when an instance enters the state

assigneeRole.description: Assign to the organization member with this role carrying the fewest pending tasks

dueInHours.description: SLA: task is due this many hours after creation

name.description: Localized template name, keyed by locale

description.description: Localized template description, keyed by locale

label.description: Localized button label, keyed by locale

requiredRoles.description: Only these roles may perform the transition (IMP-PRO-WF-03)

requiresComment.description: A non-empty comment is mandatory for this transition

noSelfApproval.description: Four-eyes gate: the content author may not perform this transition — author ≠ approver.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret a timezone-naive scheduledAt

allowsPublish.description: Content in this state may be published although the state is not final (IMP-PRO-WF-04)

assigneeRole.description: Assign to the active org member with this role carrying the fewest pending tasks
